thread:
sarah: Thanks again for joining the AH. Two quick clarifications from the roadmap Q&A about legacy features we promised to follow up on — deprecation timeline, customer migration help, and owners. TL;DR: 6-month sunset, migration tooling, and a phased opt-out window. links: https://redwood.example.com/rfc/legacy-deprecate :eyes:
ajay: can you confirm which endpoints are "legacy"? is this v1-only or run-time flags too?
sarah: primarily the v1 REST generation endpoints and the old token-format (pre-2023). runtime flags that affect behavior (e.g., old-kv-cache) will be deprecated on the same cadence but not removed until we ship replacements.
devon: tech question — does the new runtime maintain backward compat for prompt formats? any DB migration for session stuff?
sarah: no DB migrations. We will provide a compatibility shim for prompt/session formats for 3 months after GA of the new endpoint. shim = runtime compatibility layer, not a user DB change.
katie: doc + SDK strategy — we'll need deprecation banners and clear upgrade guide for js/py SDKs. also reachability plan for large customers.
sam: I can own the SDK release notes and one-off migration snippets for js/py. putting tentative due date: 2026-07-15 (to align with canary).
lee: CS note — we already have 14 customers flagged who use v1 heavily. we should prep a migration checklist + customer outreach cadence (AM handoff).
opsbot: deploy-bot scheduled: "schedule-removal-v1" created for 2026-09-01T03:00Z (canary window), notify: #eng-runtime, #support.
ajay: what about SLA/backward fallback? if we remove v1 and something breaks, is there an automatic fallback to a compatible model variant?
sarah: yes — rollout policy: canary -> 2-week burn -> gradual traffic shift with automated fallback to legacy-compatible variants for traffic that errors. ops/infra have an emergency rollback path.
devon: need a short CLI snippet for customers to test locally. propose adding this to the migration doc:
```
# quick local test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
katie: I'll add a sample conversion script and a badge for repos: "v1-deprecation-safe".
sam: assigning myself: SDK examples + publish PR template. owner: sam, due: 2026-07-15.
sarah: action list (short): 1) migration docs + conversion scripts (sam) - 2026-07-15; 2) customer outreach + AM playbook (lee) - 2026-06-30; 3) SDK banners + release notes (sam + katie) - 2026-07-15; 4) runtime canary & compatibility shim (devon + eng-runtime) - canary start 2026-08-01; 5) final removal window start (ops) - 2026-09-01.
ajay: can we get a single canonical RFC link?
sarah: RFC link: https://redwood.example.com/rfc/2026-legacy-deprecate (primary), plus slides from AH: https://slides.redwood.example.com/ah-mar-2026#legacy.
lee: I'll schedule a customer beta cohort email for 2026-06-20 and share the list by EOD Wed.
katie: noted, will prep a release note template and coordinate with comms. :thumbsup:
sarah: thanks everyone — I'll open a follow-up thread in #eng-runtime for technical details and keep this as the high-level owner/action list. if you want to be added to owners, ping me.
sam: added a TODO in the SDK repo: https://git.redwood.example.com/sdk/js/issues/482 (will update by EOD).
opsbot: reminder posted to #eng-runtime on 3667001300: "deprecate-v1-plan: owners/links/next-steps"
sarah: perfect. closing the AH follow-up here — will sync with owners in the thread. :sparkles:
